name: v0 by Vercel
tagline: v0 is Vercel's generative UI tool that turns a text description into production-ready React components styled with Tailwind and shadcn/ui. You describe a UI ('a pricing table with three tiers') and v0 produces clean, copy-paste-ready code in seconds. Frontend developers and designers use it to prototype and scaffold UI components far faster than building from scratch.
